title: WorkflowRecord
description: A production-oriented workflow template encoding the full stack pattern for a specific build goal. The primary retrieval unit in RightStack — tools are secondary.

goal.description: Natural language description of what this workflow builds. Written to match builder intent queries. e.g. 'Build an autonomous AI agent that executes trades on Solana.'

goal_tags.description: Short intent keywords for retrieval matching. e.g. ['trading-agent', 'autonomous', 'onchain-execution']

ecosystems.description: Which ecosystems this workflow applies to. Most workflows are single-ecosystem. Multi-ecosystem workflows require explicit cross-chain context.

scale.description: Scales this workflow template is valid for. Some workflows are only production-appropriate (e.g., complex AA patterns).

user_types.description: Which builder types this workflow is designed for. Affects tool selection and explanation depth in recommendations.

phases.description: Ordered sequence of workflow phases. Each phase is a distinct layer in the stack. Order matters — phases should be listed in dependency order.

required.description: Whether this phase is mandatory for the workflow to function. Optional phases improve the workflow but are not blockers.

primary_tools.description: Tool IDs recommended for this phase. Ordered by preference. First entry is the default recommendation.

alternative_tools.description: Alternative tools for this phase with context on when to prefer each.

skill_refs.description: Skills that should be injected into agent context before executing this phase.

phase_notes.description: Critical information about this phase. Tradeoffs, gotchas, ordering constraints.

scale_overrides.description: Phase-level tool or approach changes at specific scales.

prerequisite_workflows.description: WorkflowRecord IDs that must be completed before this workflow. Encodes dependency ordering that is currently missing from all ecosystem skill systems.

prerequisite_skills.description: SkillRecord IDs that should be loaded before executing this workflow.

trust_state.description: Whether this workflow pattern has been validated in production. A workflow can be production-grade even if some of its component tools are emerging.

production_notes.description: Insights from production usage of this workflow. The highest-value content in the record — encode real lessons, not documentation summaries.

tradeoffs.description: Honest tradeoffs of this workflow pattern. What you give up to gain what. Required for trust-worthy recommendations.

anti_patterns.description: Common mistakes when implementing this workflow. These become repo-audit flags.

constraint_modifiers.description: How specific builder constraints change this workflow's recommendations.

derived_from.description: Where this workflow pattern was observed. e.g. 'WORKFLOWS.md', 'corpus-analysis-v1'
